scope: Cross-factor regression of first-sync group loading, queue cancellation, notification recovery and membership state

findings_fixed.case: Normal notification emits 1005 updates into capacity-1000 own queue while live work arrives
findings_fixed.baseline: Context deadline exceeded because synchronous notification consumer cannot drain itself
findings_fixed.fix: Run notification persistence as protected work while listener drains; apply pending writes serially after completion

findings_fixed.case: Protected bootstrap buffers metadata retry followed by live update
findings_fixed.baseline: Pending live update waits indefinitely behind metadata retry
findings_fixed.fix: Cancel newly started unprotected metadata when pending work already exists

findings_fixed.case: Deleted placeholder plus group notification with injected storage failure, deadline or cancellation
findings_fixed.baseline: Group error is swallowed and checkpoint advances from 1 to 3
findings_fixed.fix: Propagate group notification error; retain checkpoint 1 and advance to 3 only on successful replay

findings_fixed.case: Receipt expires after notification processing starts
findings_fixed.baseline: Running notification has no receipt deadline in context
findings_fixed.fix: Derive notification context from receipt deadline and check cancellation before dispatch and checkpoint

findings_fixed.case: Repeated syncEnded plus slow membership query
findings_fixed.baseline: 8 queries instead of 1; each completion restarts timeout
findings_fixed.fix: Handle completion once per sync cycle and preserve single-flight query

findings_fixed.case: First sync plus connecting, connection failure or connection success plus retry
findings_fixed.baseline: Connection state overwrites sync status and permits 2 premature membership reads
findings_fixed.fix: Retain sync phase across connection changes; non-reinstall completion still clears initial sync state

findings_fixed.case: Leave, rejoin and delayed role query
findings_fixed.baseline: Previous owner/admin claim becomes active again
findings_fixed.fix: Invalidate elevated self role, app-manager level and self-owner claim on leaving

checks.mobile_locked_source: PASS: same five packages with CGO and race detector
checks.stress: PASS: targeted queue, cancellation, pending retry, checkpoint and deadline regressions repeated 30 times under race detector
checks.logout: PASS: canceled lock owner can drain more than channel capacity; no old-account updates applied
checks.flutter: PASS: 90 loading, permission and member lifecycle tests, including 12 new cases
checks.flutter_page: PASS: 2 unresolved-membership page tests, light and dark
checks.analysis: PASS: scoped Dart analyze, no issues
checks.patch_roundtrip: PASS: 442 files match reconstructed cumulative patch; go.mod, go.sum and version/version are declared overlays

limitations: Storage failure is injected, not a physical disk-full test. Queue and SDK-channel scenarios are deterministic fixtures, not production load testing.
No Android AAR/APK or iOS framework/app rebuilt in this pass; old native binaries do not contain these fixes.
No physical-device weak-network, long-duration or process-kill acceptance test in this pass.
Existing unrelated narrow-screen page test expects 5 chevrons but renders 4; previously reproduced against HEAD and not modified.
No production restart, deployment or data mutation performed. Arbitrary combinations are not claimed exhaustively verified.
